title: Bahrain Company Formation: WLL, SPC and Branch Setup with 100% Foreign Ownership
description: How to register a company in Bahrain: WLL, Single Person Company and branch options, Sijilat registration, 10% VAT, no corporate tax for most businesses and visa tips.
lead: How to register a company in Bahrain: WLL, Single Person Company and branch options, Sijilat registration, 10% VAT, no corporate tax for most businesses and visa tips.
body:
Bahrain is often chosen by entrepreneurs who want a fast, cost-effective Gulf base. Most sectors allow full foreign ownership, set-up is relatively quick and the tax regime is business friendly.

Common entity types

  • WLL: With Limited Liability company, the most popular choice for trading and services
  • SPC: Single Person Company for one owner
  • Branch of a foreign company
  • Holding or offshore structures for specific needs

Registration steps

  1. Reserve the business name through the Sijilat commercial registration portal.
  2. Choose the activity and legal form and prepare the Memorandum of Association.
  3. Obtain Commercial Registration and the required licences.
  4. Register with the municipality and with the Social Insurance Organisation (GOSI) if you employ people.
  5. Register for VAT with the National Bureau for Revenue (NBR) if your turnover requires it.
  6. Open a bank account and arrange visas.

Tax snapshot

  • Corporate tax: generally none for most businesses, with special rules for oil and gas and for large multinational groups
  • VAT: 10 percent
  • Personal income tax: none
  • Social insurance contributions apply to employees

Why founders choose Bahrain

Lower operating costs than many Gulf cities, strong banking, easy access to Saudi Arabia through the King Fahd Causeway and a supportive regulator.

Compliance after set-up

Renew your commercial registration, file VAT returns where registered, keep proper accounts and update records when shareholders or activities change.
